entries.review: SDKs checked against proxy.golang.org, registry.npmjs.org and pypi.org; hosts api.twilio.com and the per-product <product>.twilio.com domains and env TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_REGION, TWILIO_EDGE read from the twilio npm source NuGet ids checked against api.nuget.org on 2026-11-11 (a name ending in .* is a family, each prefix confirmed through its members).

entries.name: UpCloud
entries.review: SDKs checked against the Go proxy and PyPI; api.upcloud.com from upcloud-go-api and upcloud-api; UPCLOUD_USERNAME/UPCLOUD_TOKEN from upcloud-api.

entries.name: UploadThing
entries.review: SDKs checked against npm; api.uploadthing.com, ingest.uploadthing.com, ufs.sh and utfs.io (file URLs) and UPLOADTHING_TOKEN from the uploadthing package code (docs.uploadthing.com not reachable).

entries.name: Upstash
entries.review: SDKs checked against their registries on 2026-10-29; hosts and env names read from the default base URLs and env lookups in the official SDK source downloaded from those registries (provider doc sites were not reachable from this session); qstash.upstash.io in @upstash/qstash, database URLs come from UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL (*.upstash.io); every package in the @upstash npm scope is Upstash's client for its own services.

entries.name: Vercel
entries.review: SDKs checked against npm (@vercel/edge-config is deprecated, renamed to @vercel/global-config, kept as still widely used; @vercel/kv and @vercel/postgres left out, they now front Upstash and Neon); api.vercel.com, blob.vercel-storage.com, va.vercel-scripts.com and VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN from the package code; vercel.com docs not reachable; vercel.app left out (customer apps).

entries.name: Viva Wallet
entries.review: no SDK; hosts api.vivapayments.com, accounts.vivapayments.com and demo-* variants from the provider's docs as returned by web search (docs sites unreachable from the sandbox for direct fetch); env prefix from convention; no official SDK

entries.name: Vonage (ex Nexmo)

entries.name: Voyage AI

entries.name: Weaviate Cloud

entries.name: ZITADEL Cloud
entries.review: no SDK; hosts instance domains [name][number].zitadel.cloud from the provider's docs as returned by web search (docs sites unreachable from the sandbox for direct fetch); env prefix left empty; no SDKs or env prefix on purpose: zitadel-go and ZITADEL_ are equally used against self-hosted ZITADEL, which is not this party
